name: Giri
credit: Real 3D capture of Giri, Berlin. Hosted and rendered by Kukan AI, embedded live. Not our venue, not modified.
note: Verified: Giri UG operates a cafe/restaurant and bar at this address. The walkthrough is Kukan's own embeddable viewer.

viewpoints.label: Where the tour opens
viewpoints.note: The exact camera the Kukan share link opens at.

how_to_add: Walk to a spot inside the embedded tour, copy the pos and rot from Kukan's own share link, then run: python3 tools/real_venue.py --add-viewpoint bar --label 'At the bar' --pos X,Y,Z --rot X,Y,Z   and map it with --map-table t13 --viewpoint bar
